blind.description: A stylized wooden dining chair featuring an olive-green upholstered seat bordered with brass nailhead studs. It has two turned front legs with brass-capped feet, straight rear legs connected by sturdy stretchers, and a carved backrest with three vertical slats topped by an arched, decorated crest rail. The model has solid, clean surfaces with a stylized painted wooden texture.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a square green cushion framed by brown wood with small gold studs along the front and side edges, backed by the top bar of the wooden backrest, casting a clear chair-shaped shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 ft tall) and about 1.5 to 2 ft wide.
